title: "Teaching"
editor: visual

Stats, research methods, and everything around them — for undergrads working toward their senior projects and beyond.

<div class="class-container">

<div class="course-detail-card">
<div class="course-detail-kicker">Instructor</div>
<div class="course-detail-title">Statistics for Psychology</div>
<p class="course-detail-body">Descriptive and inferential statistics for the behavioral sciences — central tendency, hypothesis testing, correlation, regression, t-tests, and ANOVA, with hands-on statistical software practice.</p>
<div class="institution-badge">FSC</div>
</div>

<div class="course-detail-card">
<div class="course-detail-kicker">Instructor</div>
<div class="course-detail-title">Introduction to Psychology</div>
<p class="course-detail-body">A survey of core psychological concepts — research methods, the biological bases of behavior, learning, memory, personality, and psychopathology — across the full landscape of the field.</p>
<div class="institution-badge">FSC</div>
</div>

<div class="course-detail-card">
<div class="course-detail-kicker">Instructor</div>
<div class="course-detail-title">Research Methods</div>
<p class="course-detail-body">The scientific method in applied psychology — hypothesis formulation, experimental design, data collection and analysis, and research report writing, with a hands-on lab component.</p>
<div class="institution-badge">FSC</div>
</div>

<div class="course-detail-card">
<div class="course-detail-kicker">Instructor</div>
<div class="course-detail-title">Senior Project I/II</div>
<p class="course-detail-body">The capstone internship or research experience for Applied Psychology seniors — apply classroom knowledge in a real workplace, research assistantship, or independent project.</p>
<div class="institution-badge">FSC</div>
</div>

<div class="course-detail-card">
<div class="course-detail-kicker">Instructor</div>
<div class="course-detail-title">Research Design and Analysis I</div>
<p class="course-detail-body">An empirical-science foundation for psychology majors — how psychologists build and evaluate research, from study design through APA-style reporting.</p>
<div class="institution-badge">SUNY OW</div>
</div>

<div class="course-detail-card">
<div class="course-detail-kicker">Instructor</div>
<div class="course-detail-title">Senior Project</div>
<p class="course-detail-body">The culminating research seminar for the BA program — students design and complete an original research paper or creative project under close faculty mentorship.</p>
<div class="institution-badge">NYU</div>
</div>

<div class="course-detail-card lab">
<div class="course-detail-kicker">Lab Instructor</div>
